title: Belgium – Oxygen therapy unit – Raamovereenkomst voor langdurige zuurstoftherapie voor het Ziekenhuis Oost-Limburg
description: Deze overheidsopdracht betreft het leveren van langdurige zuurstoftherapie aan patiënten binnen de zuurstofconventie. Meer bepaald het leveren en installeren van het toestel, medische zuurstof en toebehoren bij de patiënten thuis, alsook het onderhoud, opvolgen en begeleiden van de patiënten, indien van toepassing en volgens de richtlijnen van de conventie. Meer specifiek betreft het de levering en installatie van: - Zuurstoftherapie met vaste zuurstofconcentrator - Zuurstoftherapie met een vaste zuurstofconcentrator en vulcompressor - Zuurstoftherapie met een vaste en draagbare zuurstofconcentrator - Zuurstoftherapie met een draagbare zuurstofconcentrator - Zuurstoftherapie met vloeibare zuurstof De opdrachtnemer voorziet eveneens in een digitaal opvolgplatform. Het Ziekenhuis Oost-Limburg werkt op heden met Pneumonline te campus Sint-Jan. Te ZOL Maas en Kempen is tot heden geen digitaal opvolgsysteem van toepassing. Er is geen verplichte overdracht van bestaande patiënten naar de gegunde opdrachtnemer(s). Bestaande patiënten blijven verder begeleid door hun huidige zorgverstrekker. De in de opdrachtdocumenten opgenomen verdeelsleutel is uitsluitend van toepassing op nieuwe patiënten die vanaf de start van de raamovereenkomst worden opgestart. De aanbestedende overheid behoudt zich evenwel het recht voor om in individuele dossiers anders te beslissen indien dit in het belang van de continuïteit van de zorg of de goede uitvoering van de opdracht noodzakelijk wordt geacht.

title: 26172 Sakssystem
description: Konkurransen gjelder levering av saksbehandling, eByggesak og ePlansak. Anskaffelsens verdi anslås til under EØS terskelverdi. Volumet er et estimat og er ikke bindende for oppdragsgiver. For nærmere informasjon viser vi til anskaffelsesdokumentene. Oppdragsgiver tar forbehold om avlysning av konkurransen, blant annet i forbindelse med budsjettmessig dekning. Denne anskaffelsen er etter sin art vurdert til å ha en uvesentlig innvirkning på klima og miljø, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5b tredje ledd. Begrunnelsen for dette er at anskaffelsen gjelder kjøp av en digital løsning for saksbehandling, eByggesak og ePlansak der anskaffelsens art medfører at oppdragsgiver er avskåret fra å påvirke klima og miljøpåvirkningen, siden krav og kriterier som retter seg mot disse elementene ikke vil ha tilstrekkelig tilknytning til leveransen, jf. DFØs miljøveileder. Plikten til å stille krav om lærling er vurdert til å gjelde for denne anskaffelsen, jf. anskaffelsesloven § 5h. Se kontrakten for mer informasjon.

title: Skolesekker til skolestartere i Trøndelag 2027
description: Bakgrunn Trøndelag fylkeskommune, ved Fylkets trafikksikkerhetsutvalg, tildeler hvert år en skolesekk til alle skolestartere i grunnskolen. Ordningen er først og fremst et trafikksikkerhetstiltak, men også et profileringstiltak for Trøndelag fylkeskommune. Sekkene skal gjøre elevene synlige i trafikken, både i dagslys og i mørke. Hver høst blir alle kommunene i fylket bedt om å melde inn antall førsteklassinger. Kommunene bes samtidig om å sørge for at skolene informerer foreldre og elever om at elevene vil få skolesekk. Oppdragsgiver har derfor behov for gode, funksjonelle og svært attraktive sekker, slik at skolestarterne ønsker å bruke dem. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget omfatter levering av ca. 5.000 – 5.500 sekker. Endelig antall avtales ved kontraktsinngåelse. Oppdraget omfatter også at leverandøren sørger for utlevering av skolesekkene til ca. 40 lokasjoner (kommuner og fylkeshus) i Trøndelag innen leveringsfristen angitt i kravspesifikasjonen. Skolesekkene skal leveres i esker, for eksempel med 15 sekker i hver kartong. For mindre kommuner med behov for færre sekker enn en hel eske, kan annen emballering benyttes. Leveringsadresser og antall sekker til hver lokasjon avtales med leverandøren før utlevering. Vedlegget «Leveringsadresser og antall skolesekker» viser et eksempel på omfanget av utleveringen, og angir antall sekker og adresser for utlevering i 2026. Oppdatert liste med antall for utlevering i 2027 vil bli oversendt valgt leverandør i forkant av leveringen. Sekkene skal fortrinnsvis leveres til kommunene i midten av mai. Kommunene er ansvarlige for videre fordeling til de enkelte skolene. Skolene deler vanligvis ut sekkene til elevene i forbindelse med bli kjent-dager eller ved skolestart. Beskrivelse av skolesekken Sekkene skal ha en godt synlig basisfarge og være utstyrt med reflekser som er synlige fra alle sider. Økt opplevd trygghet kan bidra til at flere velger å gå til skolen, noe som også fremmer god folkehelse. Sekkens farge og mønster endres hvert år, og i 2027 skal sekken være blå (teal). Dette bidrar til at hvert skoletrinn, fra 1. til 3. trinn, får sin unike sekk. Hovedfargene rulleres i en treårssyklus og er gul, blå (teal) og oransje. Fylkeskommunen bestemmer mønsteret på sekken, se vedlegget «Profileringsbeskrivelse». Alle skolestartere skal ha en funksjonell skolesekk. Dersom det oppstår skader som gjør at sekken ikke kan brukes, skal den repareres. Fylkeskommunen ønsker ikke at skolesekker kastes. Ordninger for reparasjon og eventuell innsamling av brukte sekker til andre formål skal beskrives i tilbudet. Det er en fordel om reparasjon kan gjennomføres i nærheten av brukeren. Reparasjon bør kunne omfatte bytte av klips, glidelås eller glider, samt sømreparasjoner og lignende.

title: Levering av personell til vakthold og observasjon
description: Bakgrunn Heim kommune har behov for å etablere en rammeavtale for levering av personell til vakthold og observasjon i særskilte situasjoner innen helse- og omsorgstjenestene. Behovet oppstår når enkelte tjenestemottakere i perioder har en atferd som medfører betydelig uro, utagering eller risiko for skade på seg selv eller andre, og hvor det er nødvendig med ekstra bemanning for å ivareta trygghet og sikkerhet. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre tilgang til egnet og kvalifisert personell som kan støtte kommunens tjenester i krevende vaktsituasjoner. Tjenesten skal bidra til å forebygge vold og skade, styrke tryggheten for tjenestemottakere og ansatte, og legge til rette for forsvarlig drift når det er behov for kontinuerlig observasjon eller fast vakthold. Oppdragene kan oppstå ved ulike tjenestesteder, herunder institusjon, omsorgsbolig og hjemmebaserte tjenester. Behovet vil kunne variere i både omfang og varighet, fra kortvarige oppdrag til lengre perioder med sammenhengende vakthold. Anskaffelsen skal derfor gi kommunen en forutsigbar og fleksibel løsning når slike situasjoner oppstår. Leverandørens personell skal være et supplement til kommunens egne tjenester og skal samhandle med kommunens ansatte innenfor avtalte rammer. Anskaffelsen omfatter ikke akutt beredskap eller oppgaver som ligger til politi, nødetater eller kommunens faglige behandlingsansvar. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder levering av personell til vakthold og observasjon ved særskilte behov i Heim kommunes helse- og omsorgstjenester. Leveransen skal dekke behov for tilstedeværelse og oppfølging i situasjoner der en tjenestemottaker har uro, utagerende atferd eller annen risikofylt atferd som gjør det nødvendig med ekstra bemanning. Oppdraget omfatter personell som kan bidra med fast vakthold eller observasjon, og som kan støtte kommunens ansatte gjennom rolig, profesjonell og konfliktdempende tilstedeværelse. Leveransen skal også omfatte enkel rapportering og nødvendig koordinering med kommunens helsepersonell på vakt. Det etterspørres personell med relevant erfaring fra tilsvarende situasjoner og med kompetanse i å møte mennesker med utfordrende atferd på en trygg og hensiktsmessig måte. Personellet skal kunne samhandle godt med kommunens ansatte og bidra til en forsvarlig gjennomføring av oppdraget. Oppdragene kan gjennomføres på ulike tjenestesteder i kommunen og kan variere i varighet og omfang. Leveransen skal derfor være fleksibel og kunne tilpasses kommunens løpende behov innenfor rammene av rammeavtalen. Rammeavtalen gir Heim kommune rett til å kjøpe tjenester som er dekket av denne rammeavtalen innenfor rammeavtalens omfang og varighet. Heim kommune er ikke forpliktet til å kjøpe noen bestemt mengde tjenester i rammeavtaleperioden.

title: Netherlands – Soil-decontamination work – Bodemsanering Blekerijweg fase 2 kwelzone
description: De opdracht betreft de uitvoering van fase II van de bodemsanering Blekerijweg te IJsselmuiden en richt zich op de sanering van de verontreiniging in de kwelzone in de Koekoekspolder. In dit gebied treedt verontreinigd grondwater (met name cis-1,2-dichlooretheen en vinylchloride) uit naar het ondiepe grondwater en het oppervlaktewater, wat leidt tot gebruiksbeperkingen en overschrijding van milieukwaliteitsnormen. Doel van de opdracht is het terugbrengen van de concentraties van deze verontreinigingen tot de terugsaneerwaarden zoals vastgelegd in het vergunde saneringsplan, door het realiseren en in stand houden van een saneringssysteem op basis van in-situ bodemsanering. De opdracht omvat het ontwerpen, realiseren, beheren, in werking houden en onderhouden van een in-situ saneringssysteem, waarbij door middel van gestimuleerde biologische afbraak (onder meer door dosering van een koolstofbron en bacteriën) de verontreinigingsconcentraties in het grondwater in de kwelzone en de uitstroom naar het oppervlaktewater worden gereduceerd. De werkzaamheden bestaan in hoofdzaak uit: • het ontwerpen en optimaliseren van het saneringssysteem; • het aanleggen en in bedrijf stellen van het saneringssysteem; • het beheren en in werking houden van het saneringssysteem gedurende de looptijd van het project; • het uitvoeren van monitoring en processturing; • het onderhouden van het systeem en rapporteren over de voortgang en resultaten van de sanering.

title: Slėptuvės Dubysos g. 39 atnaujinimo ir modernizavimo techninio darbo projekto parengimo ir projekto vykdymo priežiūros paslaugos.
description: Slėptuvės Dubysos g. 39 atnaujinimo ir modernizavimo techninio darbo projekto parengimo ir projekto vykdymo priežiūros paslaugos (toliau – paslaugos). Perkamos paslaugos apima techninio darbo projekto parengimą pagal pridedamą Statinio projektavimo užduotį ir projekto vykdymo priežiūrą per visą statybos laikotarpį iki darbų užbaigimą patvirtinančio dokumento gavimo bei kitas Statinio projektavimo užduotyje numatytas paslaugas. Išsamesnė perkamų paslaugų informacija ir reikalavimai pateikiami Statinio projektavimo užduotyje su priedais (konkurso sąlygų 7 priedas). Šis pirkimas į dalis neskaidomas, todėl tiekėjas turi pateikti pasiūlymą visai pirkimo apimčiai bendrai.

title: ASIT.TO 1 year software support from ArgonSoft (Notice of Intent to sole source)
description: Acquisition Description: This is a Notice of Intent, not a request for proposal. The National Institute of Health, Clinical Center (NIH-CC) intends to negotiate on an other than full and open competition basis with ArgonSoft. The National Institute of Health (NIH) requires software maintenance and support for the NIH Laboratory Information Management system (LIMS) called ASIS.TO which is designed by Argonsoft. The LIMS was previously installed by ArgonSoft in the NIH CC/ET department under agreement # 75N90023P00826. The required software and support includes: 1 year gold system support, installation of mandatory updates and minor upgrade package, and IQ/OQ of running installation and operation qualification tests. Justification: Argonsoft is the creator and license holder for their software, and they directly provide support and renewal to their software. Thus, they are the sole source vendor that can provide the software maintenance of this customized proprietary software. Place of Performance or Delivery: The estimated Period of Performance is: January 1, 2026 � December 31, 2026 Place of Performance: NIH Clinical Center in Bethesda, MD The statutory authority for this sole source requirement is 41 U.S.C. 1901 (a) (1) as implemented by FAR 13.106-1 only one responsible source and no other supply of service will satisfy agency requirements. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. All responsible sources that could provide the required may submit a capability statement that will be considered by email (subject line to reference NOI-CC-26-000808) by 9:00 AM eastern standard time on 01/15/2026 to: lu-chang.lu@nih.gov All responses received by the closing date of this synopsis will be considered by the Government. A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government.

buyer: Office Cantonal des bâtiments (OCBA) - JDR ENERGIES
title: HEPIA - Rue de la Prairie 4 - Assainissement et rénovation des sous-stations de distribution de chauffage B-C-D-I
description:
DESCRIPTIF DES TRAVAUX

Le projet porte sur la rénovation complète des trois sous-stations de distribution de chauffage et de 

production d’eau chaude sanitaire des bâtiments B, C et D de l’HEPIA, sis 4, rue de la Prairie à 

Genève, afin de se conformer aux exigences actuelles en matière d’optimisation énergétique et 

d’assurer une fonctionnalité optimale avec la nouvelle production de chaleur SIG. 


Le présent appel d’offres concerne les installations électriques de ces trois sous-stations, qui seront entièrement rénovées. Les travaux seront réalisés entre mai et octobre 2027. 

Plusieurs contraintes devront être prises en compte par les soumissionnaires dans l’établissement 

de leurs offres, à savoir : 

• Les travaux seront réalisés simultanément sur les trois sous-stations 

• Les travaux se dérouleront en site occupé, avec d’éventuels aménagements d’horaires en 

 fonction des interventions à réaliser 

La sous-station B, située au premier niveau du parking public géré par la Fondation des Parkings, 

restera en activité durant la durée des travaux.

description: Description NOTE: On 22 September 2026, Solicitation Amendment 002 was published in the E-TIC portal, including a revised solicitation, a revised Section L and other changes, all of which are identified in the Amendment summary of changes. The solicitation also extends the proposal due date to 5 November 2026 at 4:00 pm Eastern Standard Time. NOTE: On 8 August 2026, Solicitation Amendment 001 was published in the E-TIC portal, including a revised solicitation, a revised Section L, and a Question & Answer set Batch 1. SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT: AN/BYG-1 APPLICATIONS The Department of the Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Undersea (PAE Undersea) and the Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), is releasing the formal solicitation for the AN/BYG-1 Applications requirement from the Submarine Combat and Weapons Control Program Office (PMS 425). This notice follows the previously published Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) and Industry Day event. The Government has reviewed the feedback received during and after the Industry Day and has revised the requirements accordingly for this final solicitation. SCOPE OF THE REQUIREMENT (GENERAL OVERVIEW) AN/BYG-1 is the U.S. Navy�s Submarine Combat Control System. The AN/BYG-1 provides tools for the analysis of surface, sub-surface, and airborne contacts operating in the vicinity of own-ship and within the mission theater. This analysis supports command and decision-making, payload and attack control functions, determination of ballistic data for legacy torpedoes, and initiation of firing sequence for all payload types in support of submarine mission areas. The scope of this solicitation encompasses the development, testing, integration, delivery, logistics, and full-lifecycle sustainment of compiled AN/BYG-1 software baselines. This includes current, future, and legacy AN/BYG-1 applications as part of a modernized capability delivery framework. Key objectives and technical efforts under this contract include: Deliver AN/BYG-1 capabilities and baselines in alignment with Submarine Tactical Requirements Group priorities Decouple AN/BYG-1 applications from hardware and software dependencies Implement microcontainer/microservices AN/BYG-1 architecture Transform AN/BYG-1 development and test environments by increasing virtualization and establishing a common, shared infrastructure Develop and integrate tactical decision aids that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies Assist with the design, development, and integration of combat control system elements to support international cooperative agreements and joint programs. ACCESS TO SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS AND CLASSIFIED DATA The AN/BYG-1 Applications solicitation, Statement of Work (SOW), and associated unclassified attachments are designated as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and will not be posted directly to SAM.gov. These documents will be made available exclusively via the secure Electronic Technical Information Center (E-TIC) portal hosted by the Advanced Interactive Management Technology Center (AIMTC). Additionally, portions of the Government Furnished Information, specifically, the classified software source code provided to support proposal development are classified at the SECRET level and will be transmitted physically. Documents made available during this procurement may contain classified data and/or technical data whose export is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act. Foreign participation shall be limited by applicable legal authorities, regulations, and other security classification requirements as specified in the DD Form 254. Consolidated Access Request Instructions Prospective Offerors must submit a single, consolidated access request email to the Points of Contact listed below to obtain E-TIC portal access and the classified GFI software package. Email Attachments Required: DD Form 254: A completed copy of the DD Form 254. Block 6 must verify that the requesting company possesses a Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) issued SECRET facility clearance (FCL) and SECRET safeguarding capability. CRITICAL SECURITY NOTE FOR AWARD ELIGIBILITY: While a SECRET FCL is sufficient for proposal preparation and GFI access, the Offeror must ultimately possess a fully adjudicated TOP SECRET facility clearance and TOP SECRET safeguarding capability, issued by the U.S. Government, no later than contract award. The Government will not sponsor facility clearance upgrades or personnel clearance upgrades for the purpose of proposal submission or contract award eligibility. DD Form 2345: A current, approved copy of the company�s DD Form 2345 (Military Critical Technical Data Agreement). Executed Terms of Use Agreement (TOUA): A signed copy of the TOUA, executed by the Offeror's Facility Security Officer (FSO) or authorized corporate representative. If your company is NOT requesting the classified source code, please state "Not Applicable" or "N/A" for these fields. Access requires a DoD Common Access Card (CAC) or an approved DoD External Certification Authority (ECA) Certificate, along with an active Joint Certification Program (JCP) registration number. title: Recoverable Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems for Frontline Operational Awareness and Surveillance Missions
description: The Department of Homeland Security, Management Directorate, Office of the Chief Security Officer, Program Executive Office for UAS and cUAS, is conducting market research for the DHS Drone Development Program. DHS seeks information regarding recoverable, reusable, lightweight, rapidly deployable small unmanned aircraft systems capable of supporting authorized DHS frontline operational awareness, surveillance, search and rescue, incident response, perimeter security, disaster assessment, maritime/littoral awareness, and law enforcement support missions. DHS is interested in complete small multirotor system kits with rapid deployment, operational video or imagery payloads, secure command-and-control and data links, domestic sourcing, NDAA compliance, Blue UAS/Green UAS or equivalent cybersecurity and supply chain maturity, and scalable production capacity. This Request for Information is for market research only and does not constitute a solicitation. Responses are voluntary, and the Government will not pay for response preparation or submission. 10/1/26 Update - Extended Submission deadline to November 5, 2026.

title: Stockpiling of protective equipment and disinfectants
description:
Objective of the Tender

Lot 1

A supplier is sought for six different types of protective materials and two disinfectants. This supplier will:

· deliver a portion of the quantities required under Government Council Resolution (RRB) No. 30/2026 to the logistics partner (to be selected under Lot 2) by the end of 2027 at the latest, and subsequently rotate this stock on an ongoing basis to permanently avoid the need for disposal.

· hold the remaining portion in stock as a reserve. Payment for this portion of protective materials and disinfectants will be made only upon actual requisition, in accordance with the quoted price structure. The requested quantity must be delivered to the logistics partner (to be selected under Lot 2) within a specified response time when required.


Lot 2

A logistics service provider is sought as a partner to:

· physically store the delivered protective materials and disinfectants on a long-term basis, and

· ensure order picking and delivery to end customers when required.


The volume of goods to be stored is estimated at approximately 750 Euro-pallets.


Both lots are being tendered via an open procedure in accordance with Art. 18 of the Act on Accession to the Intercantonal Agreement on Public Procurement of 15 November 2019 (BeiG IVöB; LS 720.1).

title: Sweden – Ferry transport services – Färjeförbindelse på Ekeröleden
description: Ekerö kommun avser att upphandla färjeförbindelse på Ekeröleden för perioden 2027-07-01 till det datum förbifarten öppnar (planerat 2030). Förutsättningar Sedan 30 år tillbaka bedriver Ekerö kommun en färjeverksamhet som kopplar ihop Ekerö och söderorten i Botkyrka kommun för olika trafikslag. Ekerö kommun har avtal med Trafikverket avseende färjeverksamheten. Avtalet med Trafikverket upphör 2027-06-30 och kan inte förlängas ytterligare. År 2030 öppnas Förbifart E4, som skapar en snabbare förbindelse mellan Ekerö kommun och söderorten för bil- och busstrafik. Tidsvinsten som färjan ger idag kommer till största delen försvinna för de betalande kunderna om man kan åka till söderorten och Södertörn genom den nya tunneln. Både användningen och betalningsviljan bland användare kommer att minska rejält. Eftersom Ekeröledens affärsmodell bygger på användaravgifter kommer även en liten minskning av resandeunderlaget resultera i att intäkterna inte längre kan täcka kostnaderna. Avtalstid Avtalstiden är 2027-07-01 till och med 2031-06-30. Ekerö kommun har en uppsägningstid på tolv (12) månader och avtalet planeras att sägas upp när besked finns kring förbifartens slutgiltiga öppnande så att färjetrafiken enligt detta avtal upphör två (2) till (3) veckor efter öppnandet. Tidplan Ekerö kommun planerar att tilldela upphandlingen i december 2026.

title: Netherlands – Energy and related services – Programmateam Waarm Fryslân
description: De aanleiding voor deze opdracht is dat de warmtetransitie in Fryslân relatief langzaam op gang komt door de specifieke Friese context, waaronder kleine kernen, veel platteland, beperkte capaciteit en beperkte middelen. Van-uit deze context willen Provinsje Fryslân en de Friese Energietafel de ontwikkeling van kennis, samenwerking, pro-jectondersteuning en zichtbaarheid rondom duurzame warmte bundelen binnen één programmatische aanpak. Hieruit is het programma Waarm Fryslân ontstaan, dat zich vooral richt op uitvoerende taken en daarbij voor een deel bouwt op kennis en capaciteit uit de markt. Het programma Waarm Fryslân is gestart in 2021 als Missy Wetterwaarmte om aquathermie in Fryslân te versnel-len, maar is in de tussentijd doorontwikkeld tot een breder programma voor de warmtetransitie in Fryslân. De scope is daarmee verbreed van uitsluitend aquathermie als oplossing naar duurzame warmte als opgave, waarbij aquathermie nadrukkelijk een belangrijke kans blijft, maar niet langer de enige oplossingsrichting en focus is. De opdrachtnemer wordt gevraagd om die uitvoeringskracht te leveren die er in de regio nu te weinig is. Niet door beleidsdocumenten en uitgebreide onderzoeken te produceren, maar door acties uit te voeren die direct effect hebben op de omgeving.

Les montants des recharges peuvent être choisis librement par les clientes et clients. Le montant maximal est vérifié par le système. L’avoir est disponible sur la carte immédiatement après la recharge. L’entreprise boncard payment & services sa assure la gestion et le décompte technique des processus de recharge. La branche des transports publics prévoit d’étendre l’acceptation de la Prepaid Card et de la fonction de paiement du SwissPass à l’échelle de la Suisse. Une solution spécifique aux transports publics est envisagée pour les paiements via les terminaux ep2.

description: Le présent accord-cadre multi-attributaire qui a pour objet les petits travaux du bâtiment pour les services d’Aix-Marseille Université. Zone 2 : Département des Alpes-de-Haute-Provence (04) et des Hautes-Alpes (05) ; (Dignes, Gap, Tallard, Saint-Michel l’observatoire). Chaque lot constitue un marché. Un opérateur économique peut être désigné attributaire d’un, de plusieurs ou de l’ensemble des lots. Sauf spécification particulière, le marché est désigné indifféremment dans les documents de la consultation « accord-cadre », « marché » quel que soit le lot concerné. Sauf spécification particulière, l’ensemble des dispositions mentionnées dans les documents de la consultation s’appliquent à l’ensemble des lots. La description des prestations est décrite dans le CCTP. Aix-Marseille Université souhaite utiliser sa commande publique comme un outil de lutte contre le chômage et l’exclusion socio-professionnelle. La démarche d’insertion, prévue et détaillée dans le CCAP, constitue une condition d’exécution du marché en application de l’article L2112-2 du Code de la commande publique. Dans le cadre d’un allotissement, cette clause est applicable à susmentionnés l’ensemble des lots. La mise en œuvre des objectifs d’insertion est détaillée à l’article 7.4 ci-dessous. Le présent marché est passé pour répondre aux besoins de petits travaux du bâtiment de l’ensemble des structures (directions/composantes/laboratoires, etc.) d’Aix-Marseille Université, pour les locaux dont ils assument la maîtrise d'ouvrage des travaux, à l'exclusion de toute maintenance préventive et curative. Ces besoins sont généralistes. Les travaux pourront être réalisés sous maitrise d’œuvre interne ou externe. Les travaux réalisés dans le cadre du présent marché portent sur un montant de travaux, par lot et par bon de commande, strictement inférieur à 100 000 € HT. Les cas de non-exclusivité du titulaire pour la réalisation des travaux sont décrits à l'article 1.4.2 du CCAP de l'accord-cadre. L’accord-cadre étant multi attributaire, la méthode d’attribution des bons de commande est la suivante : Le nombre de titulaires du présent marché est égal à trois (sous réserve d’un nombre minimum d’offres reçues). Chaque lot étant multi-attributaire, la méthode d’attribution des bons de commande est celle de la multi-attribution dite « en cascade ». Cette méthode consiste est décrite à l'article 203 du CCAP de l'accord-cadre.

title: Norway – Insurance services – HO-26-05 Insurances
description: Background Trysil and Folldal municipalities shall enter into new contracts for the procurement of insurances, as the current agreements expire. The aim is to establish contracts that give the municipalities a predictable, safe and appropriate insurance scheme. The procurement shall contribute to safeguarding the municipalities ́ insurance needs in a good way, at the same time facilitating effective use of resources, a good overview of risks and injuries as well as appropriate follow-up in the contract period. The municipalities would like a system that ensures stable and available follow-up, clear contact points and good assistance with injury incidents. Tenderers shall use their expertise and competence to contribute to fulfilling the objective of the agreement. Description of the assignment The assignment is for the delivery of insurance of persons and property damage insurances for Trysil and Folldal municipalities. The procurement includes coverage of insurance within the municipalities ́needs, including i.a. insurance of employees and other relevant personal groups, property, vehicles, liability and other relevant insurance coverages. Further details on insurance objects, coverages, insurance sums and excesses are stated in the price form and other requirements in the competition. The price form is a guideline for which insurances and objects are covered by the procurement. The procurement is divided into the following two parts: Part 1: Insurance of persons Part 2: Property damage insurances Tenderers can submit tenders for one or both parts. The parts are evaluated and awarded separately. The contracting authority can enter into a contract with up to two tenderers. This means that the contracting authority can enter into a contract with one tenderer for both parts, or enter into separate contracts with different tenderers for insurance of persons and property damage insurances respectively. The delivery shall include ordinary management and follow-up of the insurance contracts in the contract period. This includes, among other things, customer service, injury management, permanent gender neutral preferred and annual status or follow-up meetings with the municipalities. Furthermore, the tenderer shall be able to assist the municipalities with advice on damage prevention measures and risk mapping in municipal entities. The delivery shall also include appropriate digital solutions, for example a customer portal or equivalent system, which gives municipalities access to relevant information about the insurance contracts, damages, documentation and follow-up. The agreements shall, in total, provide the municipalities with a clear, efficient and robust insurance system, with clear routines and stable services throughout the entire contract period.
